examples.label: Brand palette in a theme settings form
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" for={%{}} class="max-w-xl space-y-6 rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 p-6 dark:border-neutral-700">
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold">Brand colours <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-1 opacity-70">These three drive every button, link and highlight on the site. Changes apply the moment you save.
<.component component_name="chelekom-color-field" site="Global" id="theme-primary" name="theme[primary]" value="#4f46e5" label="Primary" description="Buttons and links" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-color-field" site="Global" id="theme-accent" name="theme[accent]" value="#f59e0b" label="Accent" description="Badges and highlights" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-color-field" site="Global" id="theme-surface" name="theme[surface]" value="#f8fafc" label="Surface" description="Card backgrounds" />
<:actions> <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" variant="default" color="primary" size="small">Save theme
